chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhal narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Walid from Yunus ibn Ya'qub from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I heard him saying: 'Consummation (sexual intercourse) in the vagina is what obligates the dowry (mahr) alone.'

key_terms.المَهر: Dowry or bridal gift given by the husband to the wife

ai.seo_question: What condition is required for the full obligation of the dowry (mahr) in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: In al-Isfabar, Shaykh al-Tusi records this concise narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to clarify the legal threshold for full mahr (mahr al-mithl), distinguishing it from partial mahr due to separation before consummation. This ruling is foundational in Shia fiqh for determining financial rights upon divorce or death, emphasizing that physical intimacy, not merely the marriage contract, triggers the complete obligation. It reflects the juristic consensus that the dowry is compensation for the right of enjoyment, which is actualized through vaginal intercourse.
